description: Template-driven competency questions for resolving explanatory SPARQL queries over the materialized knowledge base.

CQ1.name: Observed Alert Evidence
CQ1.question: What factual evidence was observed in the Wazuh alert?
CQ1.explanation_role: Identifies the direct factual evidence extracted from the alert before semantic interpretation.
CQ1.expected_result_role: Alert identifiers, timestamps, users, hosts, network fields, rule metadata, and raw observable fields.

CQ2.name: MITRE Technique Association
CQ2.question: Which MITRE ATT&CK technique is associated with the alert?
CQ2.explanation_role: Connects the observed alert to the adversarial technique represented in the knowledge base.
CQ2.expected_result_role: Technique identifiers, labels, and direct alert-to-technique associations.

CQ3.name: Materialized Semantic Associations
CQ3.question: Which semantic associations involving the alert were materialized in the knowledge base?
CQ3.explanation_role: Retrieves semantic relations directly connected to the alert after materialization.
CQ3.expected_result_role: Object properties connecting the alert to enriched semantic entities, excluding basic RDF typing.

CQ4.name: Candidate Defensive Artifacts
CQ4.question: Which D3FEND artifacts are semantically associated with the ATT&CK techniques identified for this alert?
CQ4.explanation_role: Identifies D3FEND artifacts, defensive resources, and security-relevant entities associated with the ATT&CK techniques linked to the alert.
CQ4.expected_result_role: Candidate D3FEND artifacts and related entities that may support defensive analysis and recommendation generation.

CQ5.name: Main Explanatory Path
CQ5.question: What is the main semantic path connecting the alert-associated ATT&CK techniques to related D3FEND artifacts?
CQ5.explanation_role: Builds a compact and traceable semantic path linking the alert, the associated ATT&CK techniques, and the D3FEND artifacts connected through meaningful relations.
CQ5.expected_result_role: Technique-to-artifact semantic paths suitable for advisory synthesis and Mermaid reasoning-path visualization.
